doctrines.note: Veterancy: 5 points top, rest mid and top (of the mid) when it splits into 2 ways. Capstone unlocks "Axes of the North" (+15% dmg to infantry, renames the unit). Hero pairing: Medium or Heavy armors. Playstyle kit: 1 (Raging Onslaught, switch to axes) -> X-move in -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 -> V -> 1 -> V -> 1 -> V (repeat); can press V between spell steps to add one AA. Example build per OP: Unit Damage Doctrine V, Epic Combat Doctrine (3/6/9), Iron Damage Doctrine V (Ironsides), Linebreaker Doctrine, Anti-Infantry Doctrine or Epic Leadership Doctrine. "Tips & Tricks" is a literal X placeholder in the OP -- not fabricated here.
